prompt:
Our team has been evaluating warehouse management systems for months and needs a formal structured thinking record of the entire decision analysis process. All the raw materials are in the workspace — vendor documents, IT assessments, finance notes, meeting records, and pain point summaries.

Please produce a complete structured thinking record document called `thinking-2024-05-20.md` and place it in the `memory/` folder. The document should walk through the full analysis from problem definition all the way to implementation feedback, cover all key decision dimensions, explore both of the shortlisted vendor options as separate analytical paths, and include at least one correction where an earlier finding was revised based on new information discovered later in the analysis.

The output format and required fields for each step must follow the sequential thinking specification exactly.
